answer_1.quote: The task of paraphrase generation aims to reconstruct a sentence in a different surface structure (grammar and words) while preserving its underlying semantics. It plays an essential role in many downstream tasks like text summarization, machine translation, question answering, document modeling, and others.

answer_2.quote: Recent works on paraphrase generation typically take BLEU, Self-BLEU, and iBLEU as evaluation metrics. ... We take BLEU, Self-BLEU, iBLEU, and BERT-iBLEU as the metrics. ... we propose Entity-Score ... We adopt Entity-Score as an evaluation metric.

answer_4.quote: We randomly select 50 examples containing entities from QQP, and three annotators are asked to rate the paraphrases generated by our method (τ =5 and τ =10) and three strong baselines according to the semantics, surface structure, and entity on a scale of 1 to 3, the higher, the better.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators rate the generated paraphrases as bad/normal/good, corresponding to 1/2/3 points respectively.
